name: Libation
description:
Libation is a free, open-source application designed to liberate your Audible audiobook library. It connects to your personal Audible account to back up, decrypt, and convert audiobooks to DRM-free formats.

Features:
- Automatically scans and imports your purchased Audible audiobook catalog
- Decrypts and converts audiobooks to standard M4B or MP3 files
- Retains chapters, high-resolution cover artwork, and rich ID3 metadata
- Lossless audio conversion preserving original audio bitrate and sound quality
- Built-in multi-account support across international Audible marketplaces
